Common.tagline: Tell the story behind one photo. Stories like this add up to a book.

Landing.title: A book told by your family
Landing.lead: Pick a photo and say out loud what you remember. Your story becomes a card, and later the cards add up to a book.
Landing.cta: Start a book with one photo
Landing.flipHint: you can flip through the book
Landing.spread1Text: Talk the way you would tell a friend. We remove pauses and repeats and keep your words.
Landing.spread2Title: The voice stays in the book
Landing.spread2Text: Next to each story there is a QR code. Point your phone camera at it and you hear how it was told.
Landing.spread3Text: You can make your first card right now and send it to your family chat. With an account your cards are kept, and later they become a book.
Landing.sample1Story: “This is Dima, he’s three here. We were walking in the park and he found a fresh stump. He climbed up and said it was his throne and he wasn’t going home. I knitted the hat myself, from an old sweater. He only agreed to get down for ice cream. <hl>In March!</hl>”
Landing.sample1NoteBottom: Dima, the park by our house
Landing.sample2Story: “We rented a room by the sea, and the sofa was so pink that Dad said it was <hl>only good for photos</hl>. We put the camera on a stool, Dad set the timer and ran to us. It worked on the third try.”
Landing.sample2Who: Kate, about the first summer by the sea
Landing.sample3Story: “Dad made faces all evening to get Sonya to laugh for the photo. She looked at him very seriously. When he gave up and sat down, she burst out laughing. We never got that picture. <hl>There is only this one, the serious one.</hl>”
Landing.sample3Who: Marina, about the time Sonya didn’t laugh
Landing.postcardText: One photo and a couple of minutes of your voice. You get a card: the picture, your words and a QR code that plays how you told it.
Landing.postcardStep1: Pick a photo: from the album, from your phone, or a picture of an old print.
Landing.postcardStep2: Press the red button and tell it the way you would tell a friend.
Landing.postcardStep3: Send the card to your family chat or post it to your story.
Landing.chatCard: “This is Dima, he’s three here. He climbed onto a stump and said it was his throne…”
Landing.chat2: That’s Dima’s hat! I remember, you knitted it from your sweater
Landing.chat3: I played the voice. You tell it just like Grandma
Landing.bookTitle: Cards add up to a book
Landing.bookText: Save your cards in an account and they are kept for you. When you have twenty or thirty, we lay out a book: the photo on one page, the words on the other, and a QR code for the voice.
Landing.bookNote: We are getting book printing ready. The cards you save will go into it.
Landing.sample1Alt: A boy in a light blue jacket and a hat with red pompoms sits on a tree stump in a spring forest
Landing.sample2Alt: A family on a pink sofa in a rented room by the sea
Landing.sample3Alt: Mom holds the baby, Dad next to her makes a funny face
Landing.qrNote: Point your camera to hear the voice
Landing.faqA1: Only people you send the link to. The page is not in search engines. You can hide the voice, then the link shows only the text.
Landing.faqA2: Making and keeping moments is free. Printing a book is paid separately.
Landing.faqA3: Your browser recognizes the speech. To clean up the text we send it to Google Gemini, and if the browser could not recognize it, the recording too. We keep the recording so it can be played from the link.
Landing.faqA4: Russian, English, Spanish or German. Choose the language before you record.
Landing.credits: Photos on this page: Moscow Main Archive (CC BY 4.0), Phildars (CC BY-SA 3.0), Lars Jacob (public domain).
